title: finish_message_delivery: guard delivery_state \!= 'delivered' in UPDATE is correct
description: The UPDATE in finish_message_delivery (and update_delivery_state) guards with AND delivery_state \!= 'delivered'. This means the Delivered terminal state can never be overwritten at the SQL level regardless of application bugs. A contributor might suggest removing this guard to 'simplify' the code. Keep it: it provides a second layer of defense that make_failed and complete_delivery both rely on. Without it, a retry race could mark a successfully-delivered message as failed.
